messages:
jamie: Heads-up — we got paged for GPU memory pressure on eu-west-2 last night but paging felt noisy. I dug in; many alerts were 30–90s blips during a rolling job.
rohit: saw that. happened ~03:12–03:20 UTC, ~40 nodes flared but recovered before any pods OOMed. paging on P2 now.
leah: can we adjust alert to only page on sustained pressure? engineering was woken up for a 1m spike.
mdoe: agree. current rule is: `gpu_memory_pressure > 0.85` for 1m -> severity=P2 pager. we should make it more SLO-aware.
jamie: proposal: change to two-stage rule:

1) short window alert (1m) -> P3 ticket only, group by cluster+node, no pager
2) sustained alert (10m avg or 3m continuous) -> P2 pager

also add grouping and collapse flappy nodes into single ticket.
rohit: sounds good. +1 for grouping. Alertmanager config uses `group_by: ['cluster','machine_role']` today, maybe include `gpu_pool` tag.
leah: we should also tie to node eviction metrics — if eviction or OOM count > 0 then immediate pager regardless of duration.
mdoe: nice. here's a draft Prom rule we can use as a starting point:

```
- alert: GPUHighMemoryTransient
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_memory_utilization[1m]) > 0.85
  labels:
    severity: info
  annotations:
    summary: "Transient GPU memory >85% (1m)"

- alert: GPUHighMemorySustained
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_memory_utilization[10m]) > 0.80 and sum_over_time(gpu_ooms[10m]) == 0
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained GPU memory pressure (>10m)"
```

(note: lower sustained threshold to 80% because sustained load is less harmful than short bursts).
vincent: For Alertmanager, set `repeat_interval` = 4h for P3/ticket alerts and 15m for P2 pages. Also add `mute_time_intervals` for the low-impact nightly batch window (02:00-04:00) for P3.
rohit: We also need to avoid duplicate tickets from different node groups. Use `group_key: ['cluster', 'gpu_pool', 'alertname']` so a single ticket covers the whole pool.
leah: Ops playbook note — if sustained alert fires, oncall should check `node.evictions`, `kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total`, and `inflight_batch_jobs{owner="batch-system"}`. If batch jobs are the cause, escalate to jobs team first.
jamie: Can we add a small state machine in Alertmanager webhook to implement exponential backoff for pages? i.e., first sustained -> page, if alerts resolve and reoccur within 30m then only ticket. Prevents repeated wakes for flapping sustained windows.
mdoe: We can implement that in the router via `mute_by` + webhook state, but easier: use `for: 10m` + an additional `annotations.runbook` that includes `action: if reoccur within 30m, create ticket only`. I'll prototype the webhook logic.
ops-bot: deploybot: new alert rules pushed to staging-prom at 2026-03-17T09:22:00Z. CI: alert-rules/lint OK.
vincent: Also worth adding an SLO card in Grafana that shows "percent of pages caused by transient spikes" — helps justify further tuning. If >30% of pages are transient, we relax thresholds.
leah: good metric. also track "pages per oncall per week" for operator fatigue.
jamie: Action items:
- mdoe: prototype Alertmanager webhook/backoff logic + PR for rule changes -> staging (due EOD Wed)
- rohit: update grouping keys and mute windows in alertmanager config -> PR
- leah: add Grafana SLO panel and a dashboard for page attribution
- vincent: prepare runbook snippet for sustained GPU pressure

jamie: tagging @oncall for awareness and we'll ship to staging once PRs are up :thumbsup:
rohit: sounds good. I'll start the grouping PR now.
leah: I'll assemble the Grafana panels, want to include both rate and duration of memory pressure events.
mdoe: I'll drop a prototype webhook gist in this thread when ready.
ops-bot: ticket created: SRE-4856 "Adjust GPU paging rules for transient noise" assigned to eng-sre oncall rota.
